text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: ——And now the front-runners enter the homestretch, running neck and neck! Can the Uma Musume coming from the rear break through?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ……Foolish. Did you truly believe such a paltry wall could bar my way?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ————Know your place!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Orfevre surges forward! Shatters through pack! Takes lead! Level with front—blows right past them——!
My heart pounded violently against my chest. My fists clenched tight. I dared not blink. My breath caught in my throat as I stood transfixed by that overwhelming, blinding radiance——
————The stride of a true "King."
The moment the race concluded, I rushed toward her, brimming with excitement. And yet——

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ————Insufficient. ……A performance such as this falls pathetically short.
Far from being satisfied with her dominant victory, she seemed almost quietly enraged. It stopped me dead in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Mid-rank Trainer
text_block_list.text: ——Orfevre! That was an absolutely magnificent run……! With your talent, you could undoubtedly stand at the pinnacle……! Won't you aim for the top with me?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Your potential is monstrous! Far exceeding any legendary Uma Musume before you……! Together, let us forge an unprecedented legacy!
A throng of veteran Trainers with far more prestige than me rushed in, clamoring around her……!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: …………Fools. What absurd delusion grips your minds?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You are not the ones who choose. Be it Trainer or Uma Musume, it matters not. ————It is always I, the "King," who does the choosing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Not a single one among you is fit to serve the "King." ……It seems this Selection was nothing more than a hollow farce.
……『It is always I, the "King," who does the choosing.』 Those chilling words kept me rooted to the floor.
That day, all I could do was watch Orfevre's retreating figure alongside the rest of the rejected Trainers as she walked away.
……Several days passed. My thoughts remained consumed by Orfevre, agonizing over what I ought to have done back then——
——Pardon me, Trainer over there.
Turning around, I was met by an unfamiliar Uma Musume who bowed with practiced decorum.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Vassal A
text_block_list.text: Forgive the sudden intrusion. I am one of Lady Orfevre's retainers.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Vassal A
text_block_list.text: The "King" requests your audience. Will you accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Vassal A
text_block_list.text: ————I have escorted them as commanded.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Well done.
Waiting in the grand room was not only Orfevre, but several other Uma Musume attending to her every need. They were likely her retainers as well……

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ————On that day, what did your eyes behold?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It was only you. At the recent Selection Race, you alone stood before me wearing a different look upon your face.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Answer plainly. What did you witness in my run?

Her razor-sharp gaze bore into me, making my spine tingle with intimidation. Half-hearted flattery would not be tolerated. Desperately, I searched for words to describe what I had seen in her that day——
——On that day, a silent fury burned within Orfevre. And to me……that expression felt strikingly familiar.
That sense of deja vu stemmed from……the day I first saw Orfevre. It was the very same grim look she wore while standing before the Triple Crown monument.
She had declared it then: that she would surpass every Triple Crown legend who came before. Beyond her absolute confidence, there burned an unquenchable……fiery rivalry.
There was a clear reason Orfevre remained irritated even after crushing the Selection Race. I finally grasped the hypothesis.
In that race, she was the only one gazing far beyond the immediate field. Her eyes were already fixed upon the Triple Crown. Which meant——
choice_data_list: That your run won't win the Triple Crown

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Vassal A
text_block_list.text: Insolent……! How dare you address the "King" in such a manner——

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Stand down. ………Then tell me. What did you deem lacking in my stride?
『What needs improvement?』 Is that what she was asking? Under her stifling aura, I replayed the entire Selection Race in my mind once more.
I laid out every potential technical flaw I could pinpoint, from her gate start to tactical positioning. And as I spoke——
A new revelation crystallized in my chest. ………An intense longing. A bold ambition.
The true magnificence of the "King." I wanted to witness it—a stride capable of overturning heaven and earth itself.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ————Then forge it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The flaws you have so brazenly enumerated…… Present me with a plan to elevate my stride at once.
Was this my chance to forge a contract with her? My chest swelled with overwhelming emotion——

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ——This is a royal decree. Grasp its gravity, and devote your very soul to it.
The one who chooses has always been the "King," Orfevre. That unyielding reality anchored my soaring heart back down with sheer gravity.
